description: Fix three issues from v2 review: (1) isolated fake token stores break auth flow, (2) no concrete QueuePersistence-to-SQLite bridge, (3) crash recovery and persistence write-through untested.
steps: Export a shared fake token store singleton from src/storage/secure-store.ts and use it consistently in sign-in.tsx, (app)/_layout.tsx, and deep-link.tsx
Add a createSQLiteQueuePersistence(repo) factory in src/storage/ that maps QueuePersistence callbacks to SQLiteRepository methods
Add tests for persistence callbacks firing on enqueue/transition and for recoverOrphanedSyncing transitioning orphaned syncing items back to pending
acceptance_criteria: All auth-touching files share the same fake token store instance so sign-in tokens are visible to the auth guard and deep-link handler
A concrete createSQLiteQueuePersistence factory exists that bridges QueuePersistence to SQLiteRepository
Tests verify persistence callbacks fire on enqueue and transition
Tests verify recoverOrphanedSyncing resets orphaned syncing items to pending and fires persistence callbacks
All existing tests continue to pass
Lint, typecheck, test, and export all succeed
